When enabled, shares the TV model, Android build, runtime capabilities, match decisions and install results. Accounts, advertising IDs, installed-app lists, VPN configurations and media activity are never collected.

This is optional and disabled by default. Aptelly will use a random installation ID to retain device compatibility, matching and install-result records for up to 90 days. It does not send an account, advertising ID, installed-app inventory, VPN configuration or viewing activity. You can stop sharing and delete installation-linked records here at any time; non-identifying aggregate compatibility data may remain.
